protocol: Simulated six-hour EVA after acclimation to the 9.6-psia, 28.5% oxygen chamber habitat. The tests used 95% oxygen at nominal EVA pressure. Participants returned across EVAs.
outcome_window: Author-reported clinical outcome for the specific simulated EVAs. The slides do not give a common fixed post-EVA surveillance window.
note: The authors report zero DCS in the 19 evaluated exposures. EA4 EVA 4 had seven starts and five included exposures. EA4 EVA 5 contributed six and EA5 EVA 1 contributed eight. The pooled result overlaps these session details and the number of distinct people is unavailable.
